profile.scope: One current retained PNG Decode16 warm CPU profile; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
profile.attributionRule: Exact method names before parentheses exclude parameter types. Inclusive methods overlap and cannot be added. The last visible frame may include inlined work or unattributed native transitions; it is not a pure managed-only cost.

profileValidation.scope: The source inventory and original child build log accompany the trace. BDN cleans its child directory; direct assembly comparison covers the surviving built profile project.

rejection.reason: No useful gain: about 2.35x versus retained 2.36/2.33x. Discard, no repeat or affected timing screen.
rejection.primitive: Separate literal output admission from the merged match-length path. Huffman decoding, consumed bits, cancellation/work, history/window checks and errors were unchanged.

widePrefixRestoration.scope: Restored accepted production and rebuilt production assembly; same already verified actual package. Internal tests compile production sources directly, so their build alone does not replace the package assembly.

nextPrimitive: Inline only OperationContext.Work with AggressiveInlining; the retained optimized framing JIT leaves a separate call on consumed-prefix admission. Preserve the complete original method body, cancellation and exact work-budget semantics. One existing Decode16 screen; repeat only useful gain, then bounded affected cases. No repeat of literal-admission or wider-prefix-refill trials.
uncertainty: Profile workload loops include warmup/calibration and do not establish parity. Visible leaf attribution can include inlined work or unattributed native transitions; inclusive methods overlap. Both screens pass pre-run quietness and fail post-run quietness. Two wider-refill attempts failed before collecting any samples. All original samples and failures remain; every >2x, unknown and unmatched direction stays open.

widePrefixRejection.reason: No useful gain: 2.3131x versus retained 2.3551/2.3321x, conservative upper 2.4408x. Discard; no repeat or affected timing screen.
widePrefixRejection.primitive: Prefix-only eight-byte bounded load: admit eight bytes to an empty ulong cache or seven masked bytes when one to eight bits remain. Ordinary Read keeps four-byte refill for stored LEN/NLEN; all consumed-bit work, cancellation, cursor and framing guards retained.
